findings: The default unavailable guard is retained. Runtime enablement and specific private VPS/cross-owner transfer permissions are checked before seed/ledger inspection, export, output creation or transport. Fresh public identities still require independent ROOT authority before the sole export.

The managed submission plan comes from known canonical bytes hashed before exclusive write. Actions use authenticated C++ PREPARED SHA/bytes; the child alone receives the supervisor token and submits once. Acceptance is not finality, and an unknown Submit is never retried.

Local action/plan and newly created request admissions are retained for final full nine-field/SHA fences. VPS controls use owner-local indexes or opaque material commitments; no old admitted table is refreshed.

The observer decimal epoch is normalized to the exact canonical hex checkpoint at the terminal C++ boundary. Long waits roll only through the existing authenticated three-owner observer with three advances/stable samples, before its unchanged 1024 ancestry cap; HEAD can trigger refresh but never supplies a finalized baseline. Lifecycle finality publication/return deadlines are enforced.

The branch requires actual finalized SSZ operation commitments, two complete owner data+witness restores with independent external P/W pins, restarted proposals from the expected identities, three final stopped captures and one mandatory VPS-local signed canonical replay/accounting audit. Only that replay can close full payout/accounting; no endpoint balance-zero shortcut is used.

Whole-owner copies use explicit namespace/resource derivation and separate fixed owner-copy projections. Final original-source fences exclude deliberately resumed independent copies rather than asserting they stayed immutable. Existing core copier and original recovery/rotation behavior remain intact under default arguments and false lifecycle branches.
VPS capsules, W pins, session/Job contents and raw logs remain in situ. Only expressly approved local-to-VPS action/Job artifacts transfer; public projections carry bounded commitments/counters.

The seven protocol/opaque-FS tests contain fifty-five explicit refusal assertions; the guard test has three real child refusal cases. They are source-level component tests, not evidence that the runtime branch, Docker mounts, supervisor, private audit or complete cycle passed. Old eight pure groups are unchanged and are not requested again.
